title: Songs

filter.half: Also count half and double the tempo
filter.recent: Worked on in the last 6 months

copyTip.one: Same project as {n} other song (copied folder)
copyTip.other: Same project as {n} other songs (copied folder)

item.dragTip: Drag it onto a release in the sidebar to add it
item.newerTip: A newer project in the same folder: "{title}"

tabs.label: Open songs
tabs.groupUnfold: {name}: click to expand, right-click for more
tabs.groupFold: {name}: click to collapse, right-click for more

intro.one: {n} song matches these filters. Click a song to open it here, right-click for its actions.
intro.other: {n} songs match these filters. Click a song to open it here, right-click for its actions.

cal.workTitle: Under each day, the songs that had a project saved that day
cal.hint: Drag a song onto a day to give it a date (release, deadline). Drag it back here to remove the date.

by.dateTip: The release or deadline date given to the song (drag a song onto a day to change it)
by.createdTip: The day the song's oldest project was saved
by.mtimeTip: The day the song's newest project was saved

cal.createdHint: Each song sits on the day of its oldest project, read from the files' dates. That date is not changed here.
cal.mtimeHint: Each song sits on the day it was last saved in Live. That date is not changed here.

folders.physicalOn: Your real folders. Drag a song onto a card to move its folder.
folders.physicalOff: Your real folders, as they are on disk. To move them, turn on physical arranging in Settings.
folders.reorgTitle: Suggests filing each song folder under its artist's folder (you choose what moves)
folders.mediaTitle: Pictures, videos, sounds and notes in folders with no project, ready to send to a song's mood board
folders.dragHint: Drag onto another card to move its folder
folders.shared: Folder shared with other songs: move the whole card

risk.one: "{title}" stays put: {n} sample would be lost.
risk.other: "{title}" stays put: {n} samples would be lost.

folders.isRelease: This folder is a release: open it
folders.holdsReleases: This folder holds releases already: {list}. It does not become one itself.
folders.tooMany: too many songs for a release
folders.tooManyTip: More than 25 songs: most likely a storage folder rather than an album
folders.confirmText: The folder "{name}" will be moved on disk into "{to}", with everything in it (projects, samples, renders). Nothing is copied or deleted, and Live finds everything. Ctrl+Z puts it back.

resize: Width: drag the bar (or the left and right arrows), double-click for the middle

presets.title: Presets
presets.name: Preset name
presets.default: Open the Songs page with this preset
presets.hint: A preset keeps the filters, the sort and the view. The one with a star is applied when Spool opens.
